title: Emerald Qasr

couple.tagline: The Auspicious Royal Nikah Celebration Of
couple.invitationMessage: With the divine grace of Almighty Allah (SWT) and the heartfelt prayers of our beloved parents and elders, we cordially request the honour of your gracious presence and blessings as our children unite in the sacred bond of Nikah.
couple.urduGreeting: Aapki pur-khuloos shirkat aur duayein hamari khushiyon ko dobala karengi.

storyMessage: Underneath the starlit skies of the historic City of Pearls, amidst the timeless Nizami archways and glowing crystal chandeliers, two souls were destined in love. With the boundless grace of Allah (SWT) and the sacred prayers of our loving parents, we begin our eternal covenant of Nikah.

verse.arabic: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
verse.translation: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy.
verse.propheticDua: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
verse.propheticDuaTranslation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness and eternal love.
